terra.problem: The claim that Paran is a wilderness named elsewhere in Scripture needs a reference.
“Wrong stretch of sand” uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
The line about how Zin sounds and being “wilderness-y” makes the place name the joke.
The third month does not mean they arrived three months after leaving Egypt.
“Three months of walking” adds an elapsed duration the text does not give.
The joke puts down guests by saying nobody treasures one as much as a cookie.
It presents Israel becoming the LORD’s treasured possession without the stated condition of obeying His voice and keeping His covenant.
“Everybody in the room” adds a location the text does not give.
The passage says the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people; it does not say everybody is invited to watch.
“Nobody and nothing touches that mountain” is broader than the rule for the people and animals. Moses goes up the mountain.
Calling Moses’ instruction a reminder and saying he would not let the people forget adds a prior warning to them and a motive the text does not give.
“No one was waving a flag” asserts a detail the text does not give.
The text says the people trembled; it does not say they were not singing or harmonizing.
“The smoke followed” adds a sequence the text does not state.
The roasting joke treats the holy mountain and the LORD’s descent too casually.
The joke about a whisper being lost in the noise makes light of how God answers.
“Then right back down” skips Moses’ response and the LORD’s further instruction before Moses descends.
“No one gets a pass” extends the command beyond the priests who approach the LORD without the text saying so.
The passage ends with Moses going down and speaking to the people. It does not say he comes back up with Aaron.
The passage says Moses is told to bring Aaron up; it does not say Aaron goes back up.
